analysis: Static Hopper dossiers and bounded LLVM objdump. The original Windows executable was not executed or uploaded.

navigationSource.warning: Historical archive also includes later 2005/2006 and 2017 changes. It is navigation evidence, not an exact 3.58f source release. Rules below were corroborated against the pinned original binary.

observations.fact: UN:I admits 5..9 parameters: six adds surface, seven is an explicit visual type/subtype pair, eight adds surface to that pair, nine adds refresh. Surface defaults to -1, refresh to1.
Normal placement passes -1 as template terrain unless ERM overrides that byte. Hole124 has a separate actual-terrain path.
The original template finder scans the per-type list backwards, matches subtype and, unless terrain=-1, tests the requested terrain bit.
Resource type79 stores raw amount5, not a randomized amount.
Event setup word0x03fc00 enables all eight players, human activation, no computer activation, and repeat visits.

implementationBoundaries: Source UN:I rejects different logical/visual identities, refresh0 and original17/93 messenger variant selection until their native behavior is validated.
A terrain with no admitted template fails explicitly instead of selecting an unrelated graphic.
UN:O currently removes a unique non-hero object by anchor; overlap/hero selection and right-click description deletion require further original validation.

Core Objects.txt template order is retained for script placement; mapped WoG-only handlers use their bound native templates. This is not exhaustive validation of all original visual definitions or all object-specific initialization.
Original campaigns, quests, battles, victory conditions and carryover remain disabled or unvalidated.
